_comment: Google reviews shown on the home page. Two things write this file: a human, today,
and build/fetch-reviews.js on a cron once Business Profile API access is granted.
Same shape either way, so nothing downstream has to know which one it was.
While "reviews" is empty the whole section is dropped from every generated page —
the site stays valid, it just has no reviews block yet.
author  display name. Keep it as Google shows it, or shortened to a surname
time    ISO date. Rendered per language, so 2026-07-14 reads July 2026 / lipiec 2026.
text    the review, verbatim. Newlines survive, nothing else is interpreted.
lang    what it was written in. Informational for now.
